title: Hold a taxi licence
what: Hold, own or lease a taxi licence, and be its responsible operator, before operating a taxi service.

laws.title: Taxi and Hire Vehicle Industries Act 2008 (Tas)

sources.title: Taxi and Hire Vehicle Industries Act 2008 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not operate or purport to operate a taxi service unless the person – (a) holds, owns or leases a taxi licence; and (b) is the responsible operator of that taxi licence.
